name: How much does it cost to paint a bathroom in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint a bathroom in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to paint a bathroom in the Bay Area can vary based on several factors, including the size of the bathroom, the condition of the walls, and the type of paint chosen. Generally, homeowners can expect to pay between $400 and $1,200 for professional bathroom painting. This estimate typically includes surface preparation, minor repairs, priming, and two coats of paint. Obtaining a detailed quote from a local contractor like City Dweller, LLC will provide a precise cost for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom painting costs in the Bay Area typically range from $400 to $1,200, depending on size and wall condition.
